description: If your home has a grill on the balcony or windows, please take one minute for this. Families put grills up to keep thieves out, and that makes sense. But in a fire, a grill with no opening can stop you from getting out and stop firemen from getting in. In Bengaluru in 2021, two people lost their lives on a grilled balcony, and the city then said balcony grills need its approval. Mumbai's fire chief suggests a grill with a door and a lock that can be broken in an emergency. Does the grill in your home have a way to open?
